summary: Android experience acceptance: one device assertion per requirement. android/app/src/androidTest/java/zenpi/ExperienceAcceptanceTest.kt (no host; production AppShell + ZenpiTheme on the device): approvalBarStaysOnScreenAtEveryScrollPositionOfTenThousandTurns (10,000-turn session with a pending approval; scrolled to the newest, turn 5000, the oldest, 5 flings each way, newest again; the bar and its Allow/Deny stay displayed and fully on screen) and primaryActionsSitInTheBottomFortyPercentOfTheScreen (composer, Send, / and @ triggers, approval bar Review/Deny/Allow, sheet Deny/Allow once, Stop while running: top edge in screen coordinates >= 60% of the screen height). android/app/src/androidTest/java/zenpi/HostExperienceTest.kt (production host: zenpi host serve + the shared scripted provider from the new test fixture tests/ze591_android_host.rs, over adb reverse; skipped without the ze591_invite argument; pairs into the production store/key that MainActivity and ResumeWorker use): a_ background approval notification within 2 s of the background read (ResumeWorker) starting; b_ tapping the approval notification shows that session with its approval bar within 1 s (3 taps); c_ 30 s in airplane mode while the desktop answers 3 prompts, then reconnect: the app's turns equal a fresh host snapshot (no duplicate, no gap), each offline prompt once on screen, draft kept. New Gradle module android/macrobenchmark (com.android.test, androidx.benchmark 1.3.4 + uiautomator 2.3.0) against a new :app benchmark build type (release + R8, debug-signed, profileable) whose benchmark-only source set (android/macrobenchmark/fixture: ConversationFixtureActivity with 10,000 turns in the production AppShell, CacheSeedActivity writing MainActivity's encrypted store) never ships in debug/release: ConversationScrollBenchmark (FrameTimingMetric, CompilationMode.None, 5 iterations x 16 flings; asserts p95 >= 55 fps from P95 frameOverrunMs and P95 frameDurationCpuMs <= 1000/55 ms) and OfflineCacheBenchmark (airplane mode, cold process, launch intent -> newest cached turn on screen <= 500 ms). Result: 5 of 7 requirements pass on ZenpiStage2Api35; the approval-notification requirement FAILS on a product defect (below); the deep link passes only with the notification posted by ApprovalNotifier.sync itself, because the background read never posts it.

validation_result.device: ZenpiStage2Api35 (API 35 arm64 emulator, 4 cores, 2 GB, 1080x1920 @420 dpi, 60 Hz, headless -gpu host)

approval_notification_within_2s.status: FAIL (product defect, not fixed here: outside owned paths)
approval_notification_within_2s.measured: no notification within 10 s; ResumeWorker ran once and returned RETRY (ENQUEUED after 1 attempt); the same host read as ResumeWorker's fails with 'Host request refused: busy' (the same in every run)
approval_notification_within_2s.cause: while a turn waits for its approval the job thread holds the session owner, and the host refuses resume/inspect transcript reads with busy (src/remote/host_adapter.rs owner.try_lock() for Message::Resume and Inspect); ResumeWorker's read is not a subscription, so HostClient's busy fallback (TranscriptRestorePolicy.busyView, subscribe only) does not apply and the worker retries with 30 s backoff and gives up. The foreground app still sees the queue (its subscription takes the busy view from the workspace listing). ZE-544's own test only exercised ApprovalNotifier.sync without a host.
approval_notification_within_2s.posting_part: ApprovalNotifier.sync -> notification visible in the open shade: 816, 869, 787 ms (b_)

notes: Deviations / decisions: (1) Owned paths are androidTest/ and macrobenchmark/. Outside them: android/settings.gradle.kts (include :macrobenchmark), android/build.gradle.kts (com.android.test plugin version), android/app/build.gradle.kts (benchmark build type initWith(release), debug-signed; its source set points at android/macrobenchmark/fixture so the fixture files live in the owned path and never reach debug/release; androidTestImplementation uiautomator 2.3.0), and tests/ze591_android_host.rs, a #[ignore] Rust test used only as the host fixture (production zenpi host serve + tests/support/scripted FakeServer; no src/ change). (2) 10,000 turns: the live app keeps a 64-turn display tail (HostClient displayTail), so a 10,000-turn conversation exists only through the fixture activity rendering the production AppShell; the bar test uses the same size in-process. (3) The scroll benchmark calls androidx.benchmark's macrobenchmarkWithStartupMode (what MacrobenchmarkRule.measureRepeated calls; RestrictTo, suppressed) because measureRepeated returns no metrics to assert on. p95 fps = 1000 / (refresh period + max(0, P95 frameOverrunMs)). (4) Offline cached render is measured in the benchmark build (Macrobenchmark), not the debug androidTest: on the debug APK the first composition alone skipped 43 frames (~1.07-1.5 s), which says nothing about the shipped build. UiAutomator timings set Configurator.waitForIdleTimeout = 0; its default 500 ms quiet wait otherwise added ~600-900 ms to every on-screen timing. (5) Approval notification: production starts the background read 30 s after onStop with no push (FCM is LATER, blueprint 3.1), so the 2 s is measured from the read's start (ResumeScheduler.enqueue with delay 0). It fails because of the busy refusal described in validation_result; fixing it needs a host or HostClient/ResumeWorker change (e.g. let the background read fall back to the workspace listing on busy, as the subscription does) and belongs to ZE-544's owner, not to this test item. (6) The deep-link test posts the notification with ApprovalNotifier.sync for the approval the foreground app saw, so it measures the tap -> session path independently of (5). (7) Emulator environment (restored afterwards): headless -no-window -gpu host (the macOS window made every frame ~2x slower), goldfish-logcat (serial console logging, ~19% CPU) stopped via adb root, wm size/density override 320x640@160 found on the AVD reset to physical 1080x1920@420 for the runs and put back afterwards, Wi-Fi joined (the app dials only over Wi-Fi/Ethernet) and disabled afterwards; the host is reached on 127.0.0.1 through adb reverse, which keeps working in airplane mode. (8) Emulator caveat: frame timing and launch times come from an emulator with host-translated GL; ZE-592 owns the physical-phone receipt. (9) Estimated 500 LOC; 815 added (HostExperienceTest 314: host pairing, busy/disconnect retries of the desktop-side client and the airplane/Wi-Fi handling are needed to drive the real host).
